summary: Not needed. MIT and public, but a 1-star fork of dagrejs/dagre pinned at 3.1.1 while upstream is 3.1.3, and it is not used by the NVL layout-workers package. Use @dagrejs/dagre directly.
reasoning: MIT licence and a public repository (neo-technology/dagre), so the hard licence constraint does not apply.
It is a fork of dagrejs/dagre; upstream is at 3.1.3 (Oct 2026) while the fork ships 3.1.1.
@neo4j-nvl/layout-workers depends on @dagrejs/dagre 3.1.1, so adding this fork creates a second dagre copy with no functional gain.
Only 3 published versions and no provenance.
caveats: If Neo4j-specific patches are required, document them first; nothing in the package metadata says what they are.

evidence.label: Source availability
evidence.detail: Public fork at github.com/neo-technology/dagre (1 star), forked from dagrejs/dagre.

evidence.label: Provenance
evidence.detail: 0 attested versions in the npm registry; no publish workflow is visible without a repository.

evidence.label: Known advisories
evidence.detail: OSV returns no advisories for 3.1.1 or its pinned dependencies.

evidence.label: Suite duplication
evidence.detail: Not a dependency of any NVL package. layout-workers depends on @dagrejs/dagre 3.1.1; adding this fork yields two dagre copies.
